You show an opening with your shoulder and flick your weapon toward it, drawing their attention away from your real stroke.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
One adjacent creature that can see you.
Duration
Until used or the end of this turn.
Equipment / acquisition
Requires a melee weapon; grants none.
Limits
Repeated uses do not multiply this card’s benefit on the same recipient or prepared attack. Pay a Maneuver for each use.
Type
Skill / Attack

Gain 1 Boon to your next melee attack against the chosen creature this turn. The target need not move, spend a Reaction or accept a particular response. This grants no attack.
